metadata.title: Triviality of metric fibrations over locally finite metric graphs
metadata.abstract: In this note, we give a direct proof that every metric fibration over a geodesic metric space locally modeled on finite metric stars is isometrically isomorphic, over its base, to the $\ell^1$ product of its base and a fiber. Neither compactness nor completeness of the base is assumed. We also construct a nontrivial example over a closed interval with a truncated metric, showing that the local star condition alone does not imply the conclusion.
metadata.comment: 5 pages. Main result announced at Magnitude 2023

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 对局部等距于有限度量星形的测地度量空间B，作者直接证明其上的每个度量纤维化均在保持底空间投影的意义下等距同构于B与一个纤维的ℓ¹乘积。底空间可以非紧且不完备。作者另构造带截断度量的闭区间上的非平凡纤维化，展示仅有局部星形条件的情形。
techniques: 测地度量空间与局部有限星形结构
度量纤维化与保持投影的等距同构
analysis.breakthrough: 以局部度量图结构和全局测地性获得整体ℓ¹乘积刚性，并给出区分这两个条件的反例。
analysis.limitations: 须使用文中的度量纤维化概念，且底空间要满足全局测地条件。结论的乘积范数为ℓ¹。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
